# Patent Figure Standards — USPTO & CNIPA

> Based on USPTO 37 CFR §1.84, CNIPA 审查指南 §4.3, and patent attorney conventions.

## Paper & Margins

| Spec | USPTO | CNIPA |
|------|-------|-------|
| Paper size | A4 or US Letter | A4 (210×297mm) |
| Top margin | ≥25mm (1 inch) | — |
| Left margin | ≥25mm | — |
| Right margin | ≥15mm (5/8 inch) | — |
| Bottom margin | ≥10mm (3/8 inch) | — |
| Figure number | `Fig. 1`, `Fig. 2`... | `图1`, `图2`... below figure |

## Color & Photos

- Color: **B&W line art** (color requires petition/examiner approval)
- Photos: generally **prohibited** (unless only feasible method, e.g., metallography/electrophoresis)
- B&W mode: **white fill, black lines, zero color**

## Font & Sizes

CNIPA: character height 3.5–4.5mm ≈ 14–17pt  
USPTO: legible, recommended ≥12pt

| Element | Recommended size |
|---------|:---:|
| Box main text | **14pt** |
| Figure label ("图1") | **14–16pt** |
| Lead line numbers | **10–12pt** |
| Arrow labels | **10–12pt** |

## Line Specs

| Element | Width |
|---------|:---:|
| Shape outlines | **0.5–0.8pt** (thin = professional) |
| Lead lines | **0.3–0.4pt** (thinner) |
| Connection arrows | **0.5–0.8pt** |

### Line Prohibitions

| Behavior | Ruling |
|----------|:---:|
| Lines crossing through boxes | ❌ Absolutely forbidden |
| Crossing lines | ⚠️ Avoid; use jump bridges if unavoidable |
| Lines >1.5pt | ❌ Childish appearance |
| Decorative elements | ❌ Forbidden (no rounded corners/gradients/shadows) |

## Scaling

- CNIPA: legible at **2/3** reduction
- PNG: DPI ≥ **300**
- Lines uniform, dark enough, no smudging

## Output Formats

| Format | Use case | Requirement |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| **SVG** | Editing, archiving | Vector preferred |
| **PDF** | Formal submission | USPTO/CNIPA direct |
| **PNG** | Preview, embedding | DPI ≥ 300 |
